Kolkata Book Fair to mark 50th edition with 'Vande Mataram' theme

The 50th edition of the Kolkata Book Fair, scheduled for 2027, will celebrate the 150th anniversary of 'Vande Mataram'. Israel is being considered as a potential theme country for the event. The fair's golden jubilee will coincide with the significant anniversary of the national song.
